---
title: "Declarative hooks for Claude Code"
toc: false
body-classes: "gd-homepage"
---

<!-- gd-embed-fragment: canonical_hook -->

A few lines stop your agent from calling a UI change done before it looked at it. Each hook is declarative Python. It has an event, conditions, and an action.

::: {.callout-note}
No install step. Every command runs through [`uvx`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). `uvx capt-hook …` fetches captain-hook into a throwaway environment and runs it, so it never enters your `pyproject.toml`.
:::

---

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
{{< icon shield-check >}} **Declarative by default**

Most hooks are a single function call. No classes, no boilerplate, no YAML. You define what to block, warn, or enforce, and captain-hook handles the rest.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
{{< icon filter >}} **Composable conditions**

Filter hooks with typed conditions that match tools, file paths, commands, and transcript history. Combine `only_if` and `skip_if` for precise targeting.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
{{< icon brain >}} **LLM-powered evaluation**

Gate or nudge with LLM verdicts. Signal scoring detects patterns in transcript text, then an LLM decides whether to intervene.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
{{< icon test-tube >}} **Inline testing**

Test hooks where you define them. Run `Input(command="git stash")` / `Block("jj")` cases with `uvx capt-hook test`.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
{{< icon list-checks >}} **Multi-step workflows**

Enforce checklists before the agent stops. Tests, linting, and artifacts each gate the next step.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
{{< icon message-square-text >}} **Rich transcript API**

Query conversation history with a typed API. Filter tool uses, extract commands, check what files were edited or read.
:::

:::

---

## Get started

Go from nothing to a hook firing in Claude Code. One command creates `.claude/hooks/`, wires Claude Code's settings, drops an example hook, and installs the skills:

```bash
uvx capt-hook init
```
